latest.title: Replace AWS Access Keys and aws sso login with one YubiKey touch
latest.description: Vouch is an open-source credential broker that replaces long-lived AWS access keys - and the daily ritual of running aws sso login across every account - with short-lived, hardware-backed credentials. One tap on a FIDO2 key federates you into every AWS account in your Organization through AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity, and into SSH, GitHub, Docker, and EKS too. Phishing-resistant, attributable in CloudTrail, and built on the native AWS identity federation you already trust.

latest.title: Build Self-Correcting AI Agents with Strands Steering
latest.description: AI agents drift from instructions as conversations get longer. This post shows you how to build a self-correcting feedback loop using Strands Agents SDK steering hooks where a second model evaluates and corrects the first one's output before the user ever sees it.

latest.title: AWS Community Days: Where Builders Learn Together
latest.description: There's something different about an event where the speakers are your peers, the organizers are volunteers who do this out of passion, and the agenda was shaped by the community itself. That's exactly what AWS Community Days are, and they're happening in cities across every continent, every year.

latest.title: Securing Agentic AI on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore: Zero-Trust Private Networking and Identity Patterns
latest.description: Learn how to secure agentic AI applications on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore using VPC interface endpoints, VPC Lattice private egress, and AgentCore Identity's OAuth On-Behalf-Of token exchange. This guide covers network isolation, least-privilege access control, zero-trust identity, and observability: everything you need to deploy autonomous agents at enterprise scale.

latest.title: When Voice Agents Get a Screen: Building a Vocal and Visual Drive-Thru Experience
latest.description: We built a drive-thru app where customers order by voice while the agent controls what they see on screen in real-time. Here's how we combined Nova Sonic, Strands Agents, and a React frontend into a seamless vocal and visual experience.

latest.title: Dynamic Looping Comes to AWS SAM
latest.description: AWS SAM CLI now supports CloudFormation Language Extensions, bringing Fn::ForEach, Fn::Length, Fn::ToJsonString, FindInMap with default values, and conditional deletion policies to your local development workflow. Define a resource once and generate as many as you need. Build, invoke, validate, package, deploy, and sync all work with language extensions out of the box. This post walks through each extension with working examples and shows how SAM CLI handles dynamic looping end-to-end.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description:
ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is a scientific claim verification engine built  for the AI era — where information can be generated instantly, but trust cannot, to address the growing problem of hallucinated citations and  AI-generated information.

Instead of probabilistic prediction, ASET retrieves, analyzes, and synthesizes evidence from 1.2M+ indexed research papers to produce literature-backed verification reports for claims extracted from text, documents, webpages, images, and videos.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: NeuroVoice
trending.description: Small moments, repeated daily, reveal what single snapshots never can - patterns that quietly signal neurological risk. NeuroVoice is a multimodal Parkinson’s screening platform that tracks pattern over time to detect subtle neurological changes early.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: Global Impact AI Navigator
trending.description: Global Impact AI Navigator (GIAN) is a multi-agent AI platform built on Amazon Bedrock that transforms a raw idea into a complete strategic package in under 60 seconds — SWOT diagnostic, live-grounded funding discovery, personalized roadmap, and a context-aware advisor. Designed for innovators in emerging markets, it democratizes access to the strategic guidance that usually requires expensive consultants or elite networks.
